property_summary: For any caller who is the admin and any provided _owner address, calling setOwner(_owner) on the correct contract sets owner to exactly the provided _owner; the mutant overwrites owner with tx.origin so for some combinations (when msg.sender != tx.origin) the resulting owner differs.
change_summary: Added an unconditional assignment that sets owner to tx.origin instead of the provided _owner, changing observable owner after call.
